subject.title: fix(memory-core): unify QMD multi-collection search, add phase timings, fix archived-session identity loss

question: Should the three new QMD runtime-debug fields become a supported public memory-host SDK contract, or should this PR keep the added observability internal to memory-core?
rationale: The patch exports new `@public` types and fields; repository policy treats plugin API additions as compatibility-sensitive and requires maintainer-visible direction before the contract is established.

options.title: Approve the public debug contract
options.body: Keep the exported fields, document their intended stability, and add focused host-SDK compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep telemetry internal for now
options.body: Retain the QMD search behavior change while removing the new public debug schema until an owner wants to support it permanently.

recommendation.title: Keep telemetry internal for now
recommendation.body: Retain the QMD search behavior change while removing the new public debug schema until an owner wants to support it permanently.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main QMD/SDK owner should decide whether the new exported debug fields are a permanent plugin contract.
